method.samples: For every pair, the gate's own 200 minus samples: truth_gate.sampling.stream_rng(20261105, 'world:minus', i), i = 0..199 (base seed from the certificates' budget). Script scratch/stats_run.py, output scratch/stats_out.json.
method.statistics: Copies of faulty.py and fixed.py whose final line returns (statistic, decision). The holds counts on these samples reproduce the world:minus count of all 44 certificates exactly.
method.flag_threshold: With n = 200 and the certificates' per-bound level (0.005 or 0.00625), a rate flag (K2_HIGH_SIZE, HIGH_RATE:*) needs at least 18/200 holds (truth_gate.stats.wilson_lower; scratch/kmin.py).
method.counterfactual: Only for pairs whose fixed twin is not clean: the faulty twin's minus rate at the fixed twin's 95th percentile on the same samples (in-sample, descriptive; scratch/cf_run.py, scratch/cf_out.json).
method.label_reading: case-size is read as: the structure is present and the error measurably moves the statistic, but at the declared sizes and effect sizes the movement does not change the decision often enough to be flagged. attribution_by_outcome gives the cause of each scored outcome separately; the class summary counts those.
method.counts_source: Fixed and faulty counts are holds out of 200 from certs/<id>/<twin>.json components[0].counts. zeros is 0/200 with 200 abstentions in every certificate.

class_summary.reading: No miss and no failed clean pass of B-2 or B-3 is attributed to the gate's behaviour. Misses come from faulty criteria that held in minus at about the nominal rate (at most 12/200) because the structure is weak or the error's effect stays below the claim's threshold at these sizes; failed clean passes come from fixed criteria whose decision rule is not size-controlled in the declared worlds (point estimate against a threshold at small n; ordinary t test on autocorrelated months), and those same pairs are the detections not due to the error.
